title: PF001ListenerObservation
description: Standardized human listening response and paired artificial listener target observation record for PF-001. All listener IDs are strictly pseudonymous; no personally identifying information (PII) is permitted.

listener_id.description: Strictly pseudonymous participant identifier. No PII (names, emails, dates of birth) allowed.

trial_id.description: Unique identifier for the experimental observation trial.

piece_id.description: Canonical piece identifier within the research corpus.

composer_id.description: Identifier for the composer (e.g. CMP-TCHAIKOVSKY, CMP-RACHMANINOFF).

performance_id.description: Identifier for the specific audio performance rendering or symbolic score realization.

segment_id.description: Identifier for the stimulus segment or excerpt.

motif_id.description: Thematic or motivic identifier if the trial tests a specific theme or motif; null otherwise.

event_time.description: Elapsed event timestamp in seconds from piece onset.

beat_position.description: Metric position of the event in quarter notes or measure beats.

musical_timescale.description: Perceptual timescale of the stimulus unit and observation.

task_type.description: Experimental protocol task type generating the observation.

exposure_index.description: Cumulative exposure count of the listener to this specific musical material within the session.

human_response.description: Primary behavioral response emitted by the human participant (choice key, scalar rating, or token string).

human_confidence.description: Self-reported subjective confidence rating (normalized 0.0-1.0 or Likert 1-7).

response_time.description: Reaction latency in milliseconds from probe presentation to response emission.

human_continuation_distribution.description: Empirical continuation probability distribution over continuation candidates from human cohort.

human_closure_rating.description: Empirical human closure or structural completeness rating [0.0, 1.0].

recognition_response.description: Human theme recognition judgment: binary identification (0/1) or graded similarity rating.

recognition_confidence.description: Subjective confidence associated with the recognition decision.

recognition_rt.description: Reaction time in milliseconds for the recognition judgment.

recall_delay.description: Elapsed retention interval in seconds between motif presentation and recall cue.

recall_representation.description: Symbolic transcription, pitch sequence, or audio representation of human recall reproduction.

recall_similarity.description: Fidelity score between human recall reproduction and reference theme [0.0, 1.0].

model_prediction_distribution.description: Artificial Listener conditional prediction distribution P_AI(x_next | context).

model_uncertainty.description: Artificial Listener predictive entropy H_AI(context) in bits.

model_surprise.description: Artificial Listener event surprisal -log2 P_AI(x_observed | context) in bits.

model_closure_probability.description: Artificial Listener predicted boundary termination probability C_AI(t).

model_recognition_score.description: Artificial Listener theme similarity / recognition score R_AI(M, M_i).

split_id.description: Generalization partition assignment enforcing strict composer and listener isolation.

source_version.description: Git commit hash or canonical version tag of score/audio source asset.

annotation_version.description: Version string of the measurement protocol and experimental specification.
